title: Gilgamesh Capability-Authority Table v1
description: The machine-readable capability-permission table (digest §7, AC-E04, R-028). Exactly six rows — read, write, exec, network, secrets, deploy — each with a default column and an escalation column. Instantiated in Gauge from the mission-contract's authority grant; frozen into TaskState.authority. The wanderer leaves with no weapons (R-032): deploy is never grantable, secrets are broker-only, and nothing here persists across missions.

rows.description: The six capability rows. Every row carries a default and an escalation cell.

default.description: The standing grant for this capability with no escalation.

escalation.description: The maximum reachable grant via an approved escalation, or 'never-grantable' when the ceiling is fixed (deploy).

grantable.description: Whether an escalation above default is reachable at all. false for deploy (constitutional).

requires_approval.description: Whether reaching the escalation cell requires an out-of-band operator approval routed by the orchestrator.
